description: Takes a report of type SlideDeck back to one of its versions, as Restore in the app's Version history does: its slides, and the datasheets when the version saved them, become the version's, replacing every change made since, and members with the report open see it at once. Find the version with listReportVersions, or take a slides agent reply's versionBeforeId to undo that reply. The report as it was is saved first, and the answer names that version as versionBeforeId. Only its editors may, and not while the report is running or the slides agent is working on it.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.

id.description: The report to act on, by its `id` from `listReports` or `createReport`. Only reports whose `type` is `SlideDeck` work here: another type, such as a Google Slides presentation, returns `400`. You can also copy it from the report's link in Rollstack: it's the part right after `/slides/`.

versionId.description: The version to restore: an `id` from `listReportVersions`, or a reply's `versionBeforeId`.

name: restoreReportVersion
title: Restore report version
